**Main line:** Ng3+ hxg3 Rh5#

**Explanation (coaching note):**

When your opponent moves into check, you're forced to capture—that's your leverage. Here, the check Ng3+ forces White to recapture with the h-pawn (only legal move). That recapture removes the defender of the h-file and the critical square h1. Your rook then delivers backmate on h5. Watch for sacrificing pieces with check to demolish the king's shelter—it's one of the most reliable attack patterns.
